generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Hand-built ultra-luxury fastback, one powertrain: 111 kWh Ultium pack, Cadillac-estimated 303 mi. First customer delivery June 2025; regulator rows start with the 2025 model year. Regulators class it as a station wagon; Cadillac calls it a sedan. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://news.gm.com/home.detail.html/Pages/topic/us/en/2025/jun/0624-First-Cadillac-CELESTIQ-delivered.html
